references.text: The original account of Amalek's attack on Israel when they left Egypt, as referred to in Deuteronomy 25:17.
Balaam's prophecy about Amalek, noting that Amalek was the first of the nations to attack Israel.
God reminds Saul through Samuel what Amalek did to Israel on the way from Egypt and commands him to punish them.
Saul's war against the Amalekites as fulfillment of the command to remember and punish Amalek.
Samuel reminds Saul that he did not obey the Lord's command to complete the judgment against Amalek.
The Amalekites' attack on Ziklag shows their continued hostility toward Israel.
Haman the Agagite, a descendant of Amalek, attempts to destroy the Jews, illustrating the ongoing conflict between Israel and Amalek.
